## 海军与印太 · 7 items

Naval and Indo-Pacific reporting is split between Middle East chokepoint stress and a global naval-technology race. RIMPAC 2026 closed in Hawaii after 30-nation drills, [per USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/31/usni-news-western-pacific-pulse-july-31-2026), even as new warship programs and first-time weapons firings elsewhere signaled a more distributed naval order.

- **Hormuz is still bleeding traffic.** [Hormuz traffic levels continue decreasing](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/31/hormuz-traffic-levels-continue-decreasing-houthis-in-yemen-threaten-saudi-tankers), with transits down 52.4% week-on-week and Houthis threatening Saudi tankers; this is a direct economic lever on global energy and fertilizer flows.
- **China is distributing hypersonic anti-ship missiles.** [Chinese Navy showcases hypersonic anti-ship capability aboard destroyers](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/31/chinese-navy-showcases-hypersonic-anti-ship-capability-aboard-destroyers): the YJ-20 was fired from a Type 052D, implying the capability is spreading from the Type 055 fleet to the most numerous class of PLA Navy destroyers.
- **Russia keeps producing modern submarines.** [Russia floats out Yasen-M-class nuclear submarine Ulyanovsk](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/08/russia-floats-out-yasen-m-nuclear-submarine-ulyanovsk/) on July 28, completing the hull phase; the Ulyanovsk will enter fitting-out and testing at Sevmash.
- **Western naval-industrial lines are moving.** [Rheinmetall’s GMF140](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/08/rheinmetall-unveils-gmf140-frigate/) targets US and Canadian frigate programs with AEGIS and 64 VLS cells, while [Australian HY80 steel is now destined for Virginia-class submarines](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/08/australian-steel-to-support-virginia-class-submarine-construction/), a concrete AUKUS integration step.
- **Japan is becoming a long-range strike player.** [Japan's first Tomahawk: JS Chōkai fires a cruise missile](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5jS3RsZEtOUjZ6aWZWdXJwLTRIeE1OVy1hUFJvNU4wdjFLYmV1Y19Hekt3cVQ2OUxKSHJ6RWVPM1lJa2luZkYycjF5a0Q2TnliUVNTMUl4NzlWTmozRjQxX0xsT0JhZmdGZG9sSlBUcGswcElwajg2OENVeGl5LTg) converts an Aegis destroyer into an offensive strike platform and moves Tokyo closer to allied deterrence by denial.

Closing signal: watch for PLA live-fire notifications, the next Hormuz transit count, and whether Japan’s first Tomahawk firing shifts Chinese and Western Pacific patrol patterns.

## 国际安全 · 24 items

The international security desk shows the US military is overstretched tactically and searching for new capabilities, while Europe is building independent deterrence infrastructure. The most consequential development is not a single deployment but the widening gap between US commitments and available forces.

- **US capacity limits are becoming explicit.** [US general warns he lacks forces to keep defending Israel](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxNSU1KMWtvZXFmY3Z6dmw0bk9FLXVzRXZNXzZpeEU3ZGZzdmc2ZzQybWJ2eHFvbHJ0YTZrcDN6YzhaQW1XUkVOV2hHWGlZYS13SDZpNllYbTR1TnlRVDJSczVlWTE2ZFJYZlhNVkZyUTB1cVRIMVlkMTd5QlFIWXMxRzhpN2VzbHdnQU9qMzhabTh1eWNCVXY3dFg2T3lfOVpVQ0oyZUl4RnAxMVFv), [Defense Priorities warns air strategy has tactical limits](https://news.google.), and [Trump told Americans to leave a Gulf ally](https://news.google.) while promising the military can still shield it—an uncomfortable combination.
- **Ukraine’s air defense remains a war of attrition.** [Russia rained ballistic missiles on Kyiv and Ukrainian drones hit refineries, airfields and ships](https://news.google.); Kyiv’s air force claims [445,000 Russian aerial targets destroyed since 2022](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE8tN3dGMEU3VmhUaDcyMEFJUEx6cC1nYzVodFVFejZjRU5qeTBGckVlRl9pQTBQcFZuV2hNOG1pRWdYdkJfNUZFbUNSTQ), including 91 Kinzhals and over 65,000 Shaheds.
- **European deterrence is getting new basing.** [France prepares a new air base for expanded nuclear-armed Rafale fleet](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxOaGJGTE54OTU1TXhwejZMaEhZVkFHTVdRc2s2VUpRbjE5QmJrbjV1UGc0WGNRdkRuM0t2bEZUaEdhWmlVUGpnTHJiMW5GYnpYSjNGMFl5SkJMV3ZBMjVoa1pQcTZZQkdVVkpwTmx2b3dnUnRWRnRVSW1Eck1WNFdSZmhRRQ) and [Poland stands up a Space Command](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxPc0ZWWHJKVFhSNWF5VDZTMkYtTGYwbTVNb2Y2OW5Gbk5sZ3ppUWdlYl85al80cFUtbmxGMVY1bENfdGN5bExSU2M4RXkyWVBVeVZNWk8xalBJbFFFMjlvRjlPdk94Y0kxc3otRlQ1N044ZmpJNDZZU3JGU3ptWXpVbDhHcUpxbEswNUx1OXFZMGNiLVBpUTFjWTlSaE1pNmlNdzkxMzBfZ0dtS201cnA4dlBfTWRxQ0l4SW9EVm83YllpWkE), both signals that NATO’s eastern and nuclear flanks are being institutionalized.
- **Red Sea escort demand is spiking.** [Red Sea Maritime Security Task Force commander reports major jump in escort requests](https://www.twz.com/news-features/red-sea-maritime-security-task-force-commander-talks-major-jump-in-escort-requests) after Houthi attacks on Saudi tankers; this will force navies to choose between escorting commercial shipping and offensive strike operations.
- **The US Navy is looking for distributed missile defense.** [US Navy seeks submarine-launched anti-air missile](https://www.twz.com/sea/u-s-navy-is-seeking-a-submarine-launched-anti-air-missile), a request-for-information that could eventually turn SSNs into air-defense nodes.

Closing signal: watch for additional US air-defense deployments to Israel and the Gulf, and for any French announcement on nuclear-capable Rafale deployment sites.
